text.body: rasendracūḍāmaṇi 1 he bhasmāṅgaviraktirūpaguṇadaṃ taṃ preraṇādaṃ śivaṃ gaṅgābhūṣitaśekharaṃ smaraharaṃ śaktisvarūpaṃ prabho | tvāmīśaṃ karuṇārṇavaṃ śaraṇadaṃ vidyānidhiṃ nirguṇaṃ bhūteśaṃ girijāpatiṃ śaśidharaṃ māṅgalyadevaṃ namaḥ | namāmi devaṃ suravṛndapūjitaṃ gaṇādhipaṃ vighnavināśakārakam | smaranti ye nityam udāracetasaḥ kaṣṭāni te nānubhavanti satyam | siddhinandanamiśreṇa śuddhāṃ ca sāragarbhitām | rasendracintāmaṇeśca ṭīkāṃ kurve śivājñayā | idānīṃ kālanāthaśiṣyaḥ śrīḍhuṇḍhukanāthāhvayo rasendracintāmaṇigrantham ārabhamāṇas tanmūladevate śrīmadambikāmaheśvarau sakalajagadutpattisthitipralayanidānaṃ viśeṣasiddhāntagarbhavācā varīvasyati || 1.1 || arthaprakāśakāsāravimarśāmbujinīmayam | saccidānandavibhavaṃ śivayorvapurāśraye || 1.2 || laghīyaḥ parimāṇatayā nikhilarasajñānadāyitvāccintāmaṇiriva cintāmaṇiḥ || 1.3 || aśrauṣaṃ bahuviduṣāṃ mukhād apaśyaṃ śāstreṣu sthitam akṛtaṃ na tallikhāmi | yatkarma vyaracayamagrato gurūṇāṃ prauḍhānāṃ tadiha vadāmi vītaśaṅkaḥ || 1.4 || adhyāpayanti yad darśayituṃ kṣamante sūtendrakarma guravo guravasta eva | śiṣyāsta eva racayanti guroḥpuro ye śeṣāḥ punastadubhayābhinayaṃ bhajante || 1.5 || saṃskārāḥ paratantreṣu ye gūḍhāḥ siddhisūcitāḥ | tāneva prakaṭīkartum udyamaṃ kila kurmahe || 1.6 || granthād asmādāharanti prayogān svīyaṃ vāsminnāma ye nikṣipanti | gotrāṇyeṣām asmadīyaśramoṣmā bhasmīkurvannāyugaṃ bobhavītu || 1.7 || saṃskārāḥ śivajanuṣo bahuprakārās tulyā ye laghubahulaprayāsaṃsādhyāḥ | yadyekaṃ sukaram udāharāmi teṣāṃ vyāhāraiḥ kimihaphalaṃ tataḥ pareṣām || 1.8 || iha khalu puruṣeṇa duḥkhasya nirupādhidveṣaviṣayatvāt tadabhāvaścikīrṣitavyo bhavati sukhamapi nirupādhipremāspadatayā gaveṣaṇīyam tadetatpuruṣārthadvayam | abhāvasyānyatvāt || 1.9 || kiṃca srakcandanavanitādiviṣayāṇāṃ satyapi tatkāraṇatve nāntarīyakaduḥkhasambhedād anarthaparamparāparicitatvān mūrkhāṇāṃ kośāṇḍakavad ābhāsamānatvād anaikāntikatvād virodhināṃ yugapadadṛśyamānatvād atyantatāvirahitatvācca pariharaṇīyatvam || 1.10 || ekāntātyantataśca punaste hyupāyāḥ khalu hariharabrahmāṇa iva tulyā eva sambhavanti | jñānayogaḥ pavanayogo rasayogaśceti || 1.11 || nanu kathameṣāṃ tulyatetyapekṣāyāṃ brūmaḥ mokṣopāye bṛhadvāsiṣṭhādau bhuśuṇḍopākhyāne vasiṣṭhavākyam | asādhyaḥ kasyacidyogaḥ kasyacijjñānaniścayaḥ | dvau prakārau tato devo jagāda paramaḥ śivaḥ | prāṇānāṃ vā nirodhena vāsanānodanena vā | no cetsaṃvidam ucchāṇāṃ karoṣi tadayogavān | dvāveva hi samau rāma jñānayogāvimau smṛtau || 1.12 || tatrādyayoḥ kevalaṃ pakvakaṣāyāṇāmapi kathañcana sādhyatvāccarame tu punarbhogalolupānām apyadhikāritvāttābhyāṃ samīcīno'yamiti kasya na pratibhāti || 1.13 || kiṃca asya bhagavanniryāsatayā sevakānāṃ svasambhūtasakaladhātutvāpādakasya bhagavato rasarājasya guṇasindhoḥ kiyantaḥ pṛṣatāḥ prasaṅgāllikhyante || 1.14 || acirājjāyate devi śarīramajarāmaram | manasaśca samādhānaṃ rasayogādavāpyate || 1.15 || sattvaṃ ca labhate devi vijñānaṃ jñānapūrvakam | satyaṃ mantrāśca sidhyanti yo'śnāti mṛtasūtakam || 1.16 || yāvanna śaktipātastu na yāvatpāśakṛntanam | tāvattasya kutaḥ śuddhirjāyate mṛtasūtake || 1.17 || yāvanna harabījaṃ tu bhakṣayetpāradaṃ rasam | tāvattasya kuto muktiḥ kutaḥ piṇḍasya dhāraṇam || 1.18 || svadehe khecaratvaṃ vai śivatvaṃ yena labhyate | tādṛśe tu rasajñāne nityābhyāsaṃ kuru priye || 1.19 || tvaṃ mātā sarvabhūtānāṃ pitā cāhaṃ sanātanaḥ | dvayośca yo raso devi mahāmaithunasambhavaḥ || 1.20 || darśanāt sparśanāt tasya bhakṣaṇāt maraṇātpriye | pūjanādrasadānācca dṛśyate ṣaḍvidhaṃ phalam || 1.21 || kedārādīni liṅgāni pṛthivyāṃ yāni kānicit | tāni dṛṣṭvā ca yatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ rasadarśanāt || 1.22 || candanāgurukarpūrakuṅkumāntargato rasaḥ | mūrchitaḥ śivapūjā sā śivasāṃnidhyasiddhaye || 1.23 || bhakṣaṇātparameśāni hanti tāpatrayaṃ rasaḥ | durlabhaṃ brahmaviṣṇvādyaiḥ prāpyate paramaṃ padam || 1.24 || hṛtpadmakarṇikāntaḥsthaṃ rasendraṃ parameśvari | smaranvimucyate pāpaiḥ sadyo janmāntarārjitaiḥ || 1.25 || svayambhūliṅgasāhasrairyatphalaṃ samyagarcanāt | tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ rasaliṅgārcanādbhavet || 1.26 || rogibhyo yo rasaṃ datte śuddhipākasamanvitam | tulādānāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti śāśvatam || 1.27 || rasavidyā parā vidyā trailokye'pi ca durlabhā | bhuktimuktikarī yasmāttasmājjñeyā guṇānvitā || 1.28 || brahmajñānena so'yukto yaḥ pāpī rasanindakaḥ | nāhaṃ trātā bhave tasya janmakoṭiśatairapi || 1.29 || ālāpaṃ gātrasaṃsparśaṃ yaḥ kuryādrasanindakaiḥ | yāvajjanmasahasrāṇi sa bhavetpāpapīḍitaḥ || 1.30 || hemajīrṇo bhasmasūto rudratvaṃ bhakṣito diśet | viṣṇutvaṃ tārajīrṇastu brahmatvaṃ bhāskareṇa tu || 1.31 || tīkṣṇajīrṇo dhaneśatvaṃ sūryatvaṃ cāpi tālake | rājare tu śaśāṅkatvamamaratvaṃ ca rohaṇe || 1.32 || sāmānyena tu tīkṣṇena naraḥ śakratvamāpnuyāt || 1.33 || doṣahīno raso brahmā mūrchitastu janārdanaḥ | mārito rudrarūpī syād baddhaḥ sākṣāt sadāśivaḥ || 1.34 || īdṛśasya guṇānāṃ paryavasānamambujasambhavo'pi mahākalpairapi vacobhirnāsādayitumalamityalaṃ bahunā || 1.35 || yadyanmayākriyata kārayituṃ ca śakyaṃ sūtendrakarma tadiha prathayāṃbabhūve | adhyāpayanti ya idaṃ natu kārayanti kurvanti nedamadhiyantyubhaye mṛṣārthāḥ || 1.36 || rasendracūḍāmaṇi 2 atha mūrcchanādhyāyaṃ vyācakṣmahe || 2.1 || avyabhicaritavyādhighātakatvaṃ mūrcchanā || 2.2 || tattattantranigaditadevatāparicaraṇasmaraṇānantaraṃ tattacchodhanaprakriyābhir bahvībhiḥ pariśuddhānāṃ rasendrāṇāṃ tṛṇāraṇimaṇijanyavahṇinyāyena tāratamyam avalokamānaiḥ sūkṣmamatibhiḥ palārdhenāpi kartavyaḥ saṃskāraḥ sūtakasya ceti rasārṇavavacanād vyāvahārikatolakadvayaparimāṇenāpi pariśuddho raso mūrchayitavyaḥ || 2.3 || mūrcchanāprakārastu bahuvidhaḥ || 2.4 || rasaguṇabalijāraṇaṃ vināyaṃ na khalu rujāharaṇakṣamo rasendraḥ | na jaladakaladhautapākahīnaḥ spṛśati rasāyanatāmiti prasiddhiḥ || 2.5 || tannimittakaṃ sikatāyantradvayaṃ kathyate || 2.6 || yathā niravadhiniṣpīḍitamṛdambarādipariliptām atikaṭhinakācaghaṭīm agre vakṣyamāṇaprakārāṃ rasagarbhiṇīm adhastarjanyaṅgulipramāṇitacchidrāyām anurūpasthālikāyām āropya paritastāṃ dvitryaṅgulimitena lavaṇena nirantarālīkaraṇapuraḥsaraṃ sikatābhir ā galam āpūrya vardhamānakam āpūraṇīyaṃ kramataśca tricaturāṇi pañcaṣāṇi vā vāsarāṇi jvalanajvālayā pācanīyam ityekaṃ yantram || 2.7 || hastaikamātrapramāṇavasudhāntarnikhātāṃ prāgvatkācaghaṭīṃ nāticipiṭamukhīṃ nātyuccamukhīṃ maṣībhājanaprāyāṃ kharparacakrikayā kācacakrikayā vā niruddhavadanavivarāṃ mṛṇmayīṃ vā ghaṭīṃ vidhāya karīṣairupari puṭo deya ityanyadyantram || 2.8 || asamaśakaladvayātmakalohasampuṭakena sikatāyantramadhye bhūdhare veti trilocanaḥ || 2.9 || kūrmayantre rase gandhaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ jārayedbudhaḥ ityanye || 2.10 || atra pakṣe rāgastathā na syāt tenādau pañcaguṇān jārayitvā śeṣaikaḥ kūpikādau jāraṇīyastadā rāgaḥ sādhuḥ syāt || 2.11 || atra kajjalim antareṇa kevalagandhakamapi sātmyena jārayanti || 2.12 || kūpīkoṭaramāgataṃ rasaguṇairgandhaistulāyāṃ vibhuṃ vijñāya jvalanakrameṇa sikatāyantre śanaiḥ pācayet | vāraṃvāramanena vahṇividhinā gandhakṣayaṃ sādhayet sindūradyutito'nubhūya bhaṇitaḥ karmakramo'yaṃ mayā || 2.13 || āroṭakam antareṇa hiṅgulagandhakābhyāṃ piṣṭābhyāmapi rasasindūraḥ saṃpādyaḥ || 2.14 || triguṇam iha rasendramekamaṃśaṃ kanakapayodharatārapaṅkajānām | rasaguṇabalibhir vidhāya piṣṭiṃ racaya nirantarambubhiḥ kumāryāḥ || 2.15 || ā ṣaḍguṇam adharottarasamādibalijāraṇena yojyeyam | yoge piṣṭiḥ pācyā kajjalikārthaṃ jāraṇārthaṃ ca || 2.16 || prakāro'yam adhoyantreṇaiva sidhyati na punarūrdhvayantreṇa || 2.17 || kācamṛttikayoḥ kūpī hemno'yastārayoḥ kvacit | kīlālāyaḥkṛto lepaḥ khaṭikālavaṇādhikaḥ || 2.18 || anena yantradvitayena bhūri hemābhrasattvādyapi jārayanti | yathecchamacchaiḥ sumanovicārair vicakṣaṇāḥ pallavayantu bhūyaḥ || 2.19 || antardhūmavipācitaśataguṇagandhena rañjitaḥ sūtaḥ | sa bhavetsahasravedhī tāre tāmre bhujaṅge ca || 2.20 || sūtapramāṇaṃ sikatākhyayantre dattvā baliṃ mṛdghaṭite 'lpabhāṇḍe | tailāviśeṣe 'tra rasaṃ nidadhyānmagnārdhakāyaṃ pravilokya bhūyaḥ || 2.21 || ā ṣaḍguṇaṃ gandhakam alpam alpaṃ kṣipedasau jīrṇabalirbalī syāt | raseṣu sarveṣu niyojito'yamasaṃśayaṃ hanti gadaṃ javena || 2.22 || nāgādiśulvādibhir atra piṣṭiṃ vādeṣu yogeṣu ca nikṣipanti || 2.23 || snuhyarkasambhavaṃ kṣīraṃ brahmabījāni gugguluḥ | saindhavaṃ dviguṇaṃ mardyaṃ nigaḍo'yaṃ mahottamaḥ || 2.24 || mārakāmbusitasaindhavamiśraḥ kūpikodaragataḥ sikatāyām | pācito yadi muhurmuhuritthaṃ bandhamṛcchati tadaiṣa rasendraḥ || 2.25 || sthālyāṃ dṛḍhaghaṭitāyām ardhaṃ paripūrya tūryalavaṇāṃśaiḥ | rakteṣṭikārajobhistadupari sūtasya turyāṃśam || 2.26 || sitasaindhavaṃ nidhāya sphaṭikārīṃ tatsamāṃ ca tasyordhve | sphaṭikāridhavalasaindhavaśuddharasaiḥ kanyakāmbuparighṛṣṭaiḥ || 2.27 || kṛtvā parpaṭamucitaṃ taduparyādhāya tadvadeva punaḥ | sphaṭikārisaindhavarasau dadyāditaḥ skhalato rasasya || 2.28 || lābhāya tadupari kharparakhaṇḍakān dhṛtvāparayā dṛḍhasthālyā | ācchādya mudrayitvā divasatritayaṃ pacedvidhinā || 2.29 || atrānuktamapi bhallātakaṃ dadati vṛddhāḥ pāradatulyam || 2.30 || rasendracūḍāmaṇi 3 athāto bandhanādhyāyaṃ vyācakṣmahe | svābhāvikadravatve sati vahninānucchidyamānatvaṃ mūrtibaddhatvam || 3.1 || vipinauṣadhipākasiddham etadghṛtatailādyapi durnivāravīryam | kimayaṃ punar īśvarāṅgajanmā ghanajāmbūnadacandrabhānujīrṇaḥ || 3.2 || <19 saṃskāras> etatsādhakānyūnaviṃśatikarmāṇi bhavanti | mardanamūrchanotthāpanasvedanapātanabodhananiyamanasaṃdīpanānuvāsanagaganādigrāsapramāṇacāraṇagarbhadrutibāhyadrutiyogajāraṇarañjanasāraṇakrāmaṇavedhanabhakṣaṇāni || 3.3 || sampūjya śrīguruṃ kanyāṃ baṭukaṃ ca gaṇādhipam | yoginīṃ kṣetrapālāṃśca caturdhābalipūrvakam || 3.4 || sūtaṃ rahasyanilaye sumuhūrte vidhorbale | khalve pāṣāṇaje lohe sudṛḍhe sārasambhave || 3.5 || tādṛśasvacchamasṛṇacaturaṅgulamardake | nikṣipya siddhamantreṇa rakṣitaṃ dvitrisevakaiḥ || 3.6 || bhiṣag vimardayeccūrṇair militaiḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśataḥ | sūtasya gālitair vastrairvakṣyamāṇadravādibhiḥ || 3.7 || mardayenmūrchayetsūtaṃ punarutthāpya saptaśaḥ | rakteṣṭakāniśādhūmasārorṇābhasmatumbikaiḥ | jambīradravasaṃyuktair nāgadoṣāpanuttaye || 3.8 || viśālāṅkolacūrṇena vaṅgadoṣaṃ vimuñcati | rājavṛkṣasya mūlasya cūrṇena saha kanyayā || 3.9 || maladoṣāpanuttyarthaṃ mardanotthāpane śubhe | kṛṣṇadhattūrakadrāvaiś cāñcalyavinivṛttaye || 3.10 || triphalākanyakātoyair viṣadoṣopaśāntaye | giridoṣaṃ trikaṭunā kanyātoyena yatnataḥ || 3.11 || citrakasya ca cūrṇena sakanyenāgnināśanam | āranālena coṣṇena pratidoṣaṃ viśodhayet | evaṃ saṃśodhitaḥ sūtaḥ saptadoṣavivarjitaḥ | jāyate kāryakartā ca hy anyathā kāryanāśanaḥ || 3.12 || utthāpanāvaśiṣṭaṃ tu cūrṇaṃ pātanayantrake | dhṛtvordhvabhāṇḍe saṃlagnaṃ saṃharetpāradaṃ bhiṣak || 3.13 || rasaṃ caturguṇe vastre baddhvā dolākṛtaṃ pacet | dinaṃ vyoṣavarāvahnikanyākalkeṣu kāñjike | doṣaśeṣāpanuttyarthamidaṃ svedanamucyate || 3.14 || nānādhānyair yathāprāptais tuṣavarjair jalānvitaiḥ | mṛdbhāṇḍaṃ pūritaṃ rakṣed yāvadamlatvamāpnuyāt || 3.15 || tanmadhye ghanavāṅmuṇḍī viṣṇukrāntāpunarnavā | mīnākṣī caiva sarpākṣī sahadevī śatāvarī || 3.16 || triphalā girikarṇī ca haṃsapādī ca citrakaḥ | samūlakāṇḍaṃ piṣṭvā tu yathālābhaṃ vinikṣipet || 3.17 || pūrvāmlabhāṇḍamadhye tu dhānyāmlakamidaṃ bhavet | svedanādiṣu sarvatra rasarājasya yojayet || 3.18 || atyamlamāranālaṃ vā tadabhāve prayojayet | <ūrdhvapātana> bhāgās trayo rasasyārkacūrṇasyaiko'tha nimbukaiḥ | etatsaṃmardayettāvadyāvadāyāti piṇḍatām || 3.19 || tatpiṇḍaṃ talabhāṇḍasthamūrdhvabhāṇḍe jalaṃ kṣipet | kṛtvālavālaṃ kenāpi dattvā vārdraṃ hi plotakam || 3.20 || saṃmudryāgnim adhastasya caturyāmaṃ prabodhayet | yuktyordhvabhāṇḍasaṃlagnaṃ gṛhṇīyātpāradaṃ tataḥ || 3.21 || ūrdhvapātanamityuktaṃ bhiṣagbhiḥ sūtaśodhane | sasūtabhāṇḍavadanam anyad gilati bhāṇḍakam | tathā saṃdhir dvayoḥ kāryaḥ pātanātrayayantrake || 3.22 || yantrapramāṇaṃ vadanādgurorjñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ | rasasya mānāniyamāt kathituṃ naiva śakyate || 3.23 || navanītāhvayaṃ sūtaṃ ghṛṣṭvā jambhāmbhasā dinam | vānarīśigruśikhibhir lavaṇāsurisaṃyutaiḥ || 3.24 || naṣṭapiṣṭaṃ rasaṃ jñātvā lepayedūrdhvabhāṇḍake | ūrdhvabhāṇḍodaraṃ liptvā tv adhogaṃ jalasaṃbhṛtam || 3.25 || saṃdhilepaṃ dvayoḥ kṛtvā tadyantraṃ bhuvi pūrayet | upariṣṭātpuṭe datte jale patati pāradaḥ || 3.26 || adhaḥpātanam ityuktaṃ siddhādyaiḥ sūtakarmaṇi | ghaṭe rasaṃ vinikṣipya sajalaṃ ghaṭam anyakam | tiryaṅmukhaṃ dvayoḥ kṛtvā tanmukhaṃ rodhayet sudhīḥ || 3.27 || rasādho jvālayedagniṃ yāvatsūto jalaṃ viśet | tiryakpātanamityuktaṃ siddhair nāgārjunādibhiḥ || 3.28 || <3 pātanas:: removal of vaṅga and nāga> miśritau cedrase nāgavaṅgau vikrayahetunā | tābhyāṃ syātkṛtrimo doṣas tanmuktiḥ pātanatrayāt || 3.29 || evaṃ kaparditaḥ sūtaḥ ṣaṇḍhatvam adhigacchati | tanmuktaye'sya kriyate bodhanaṃ kathyate hi tat || 3.30 || viśvāmitrakapāle vā kācakūpyām athāpi vā | sṛṣṭyambujaṃ vinikṣipya tatra tanmajjanāvadhi || 3.31 || pūrayettridinaṃ bhūmyāṃ rājahastapramāṇataḥ | anena sūtarājo'yaṃ ṣaṇḍhabhāvaṃ vimuñcati || 3.32 || lavaṇenāmlapiṣṭena haṇḍikāntargataṃ rasam | ācchādyāmlajalaṃ kiṃcit kṣiptvā śarāveṇa rodhayet || 3.33 || ūrdhvaṃ laghupuṭaṃ deyaṃ labdhāśvāso bhavedrasaḥ | kadarthanenaiva napuṃsakatvam evaṃ bhavedasya rasasya paścāt | vīryaprakarṣāya ca bhūrjapattre svedyo jale saindhavacūrṇagarbhe || 3.34 || sarpākṣīciñcikāvandhyābhṛṅgābdakanakāmbubhiḥ | dinaṃ saṃsveditaḥ sūto niyamāt sthiratāṃ vrajet || 3.35 || kāsīsaṃ pañcalavaṇaṃ rājikāmaricāni ca | dviśigrubījamekatra ṭaṅkaṇena samanvitam || 3.36 || āloḍya kāñjike dolāyantre pākād dinais tribhiḥ | dīpanaṃ jāyate samyak sūtarājasya jāraṇe || 3.37 || athavā citrakadrāvaiḥ kāñjike tridinaṃ pacet | dīpanaṃ jāyate tasya rasarājasya cottamam || 3.38 || dīpitaṃ rasarājastu jambīrarasasaṃyutam | dinaikaṃ dhārayed gharme mṛtpātre vā śilodbhave 8.8 || yadi kāryam ayoyantraṃ tadā tatsāra iṣyate || 8.9 || same gandhe tu rogaghno dviguṇe rājayakṣmanut | jīrṇe guṇatraye gandhe kāminīdarpanāśanaḥ || 8.10 || caturguṇe tu tejasvī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ | bhavetpañcaguṇe siddhaḥ ṣaḍguṇe mṛtyujidbhavet || 8.11 || ṣaḍguṇe rogaghna itiyaduktaṃ tattu bahirdhūmamūrcchāyām evādhigantavyam tatra gandhasya samagrajāraṇābhāvāt svarṇādipiṣṭikāyāmapi rītiriyam || 8.12 || vaṃśe vā māhiṣe śṛṅge sthāpayet sādhitaṃ rasam || 8.13 || amṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ proktaṃ śivena ca rasāyanam | amṛtaṃ vidhisaṃyuktaṃ vidhihīnaṃ tu tadviṣam || 8.14 || bhasmasūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ śataṃ kanyāmbumarditam | ruddhvā laghupuṭe pacyāduddhṛtya madhusarpiṣā || 8.15 || niṣkamātraṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ hanti gandhāmṛto rasaḥ | samūlaṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ tu chāyāśuṣkaṃ vimardayet || 8.16 || tatsamaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ sarvatulyā sitā bhavet | palaikaṃ bhakṣayeccānu varṣānmṛtyujarāpaham || 8.17 || mṛtasūtasya pādāṃśaṃ hemabhasma prakalpayet | kṣīrājyamadhunā miśraṃ māṣaikaṃ kāntapātrake || 8.18 || lohayen māṣaṣaṭkaṃ tu jarāmṛtyuvināśanam | vākucīcūrṇakarṣaikaṃ dhātrīphalarasaplutam | anupānaṃ lihennityaṃ syādraso hemasundaraḥ || 8.19 || palaṃ mṛdu svarṇadalaṃ rasendrātpalāṣṭakaṃ ṣoḍaśagandhakasya | śoṇaiḥ sukārpāsabhavaprasūnaiḥ sarvaṃ vimardyātha kumārikādbhiḥ || 8.20 || tatkācakumbhe nihitaṃ sugāḍhe mṛtkarpaṭais taddivasatrayaṃ ca | pacetkramāgnau sikatākhyayantre tato rasaḥ pallavarāgaramyaḥ || 8.21 || saṃgṛhya caitasya palaṃ palaṃ palāni catvāri karpūrarajas tathaiva | jātīphalaṃ śoṣaṇam indrapuṣpaṃ kastūrikāyā iha śāṇa ekaḥ || 8.22 || candrodayo'yaṃ kathito 'sya vallo bhukto'hivallo dalamadhyavartī | madonmadānāṃ pramadāśatānāṃ garvādhikatvaṃ ślathayatyakāṇḍe || 8.23 || śṛtaṃ ghanībhūtam atīvadugdhaṃ gurūṇi māṃsāni samaṇḍakāni | māṣānnapiṣṭāni bhavanti pathyānyānandadāyīnyaparāṇi cātra || 8.24 || ratikāle ratānte ca sevito'yaṃ raseśvaraḥ | mānahāniṃ karotyeṣa pramadānāṃ suniścitam || 8.25 || kṛtrimaṃ sthāvaraṃ caiva jaṅgamaṃ caiva yad viṣam | na vikārāya bhavati sādhakendrasya vatsarāt || 8.26 || yathāmṛtyuñjayo 'bhyāsānmṛtyuṃ jayati dehinām | tathāyaṃ sādhakendrasya jarāmaraṇanāśanaḥ || 8.27 || valīpalitanāśanas tanudhṛtāṃ vayaḥstambhanaḥ | samastagadakhaṇḍanaḥ pracurarogapañcānanaḥ | gṛhe ca rasarāḍayaṃ bhavati yasya candrodayaḥ | sa pañcaśaradarpito mṛgadṛśāṃ bhaved vallabhaḥ || 8.28 || baliḥ sūto nimbūrasavimṛdito bhasmasikatāhvaye yantre kṛtvā samaravikaṇāṭaṅkaṇarajaḥ | trighasraṃ luṅgāmbholavakadalitaḥ kṣaudrahaviṣā vilīḍho māṣaiko dalayati samastaṃ gadagaṇam || 8.29 || jarāṃ varṣaikena kṣapayati ca puṣṭiṃ vitanute tanau tejaskāraṃ ramayati vadhūnāmapi śatam | rasaḥ śrīmānmṛtyuñjaya iti girīśena gaditaḥ prabhāvaṃ ko vānyaḥ kathayitumapāraṃ prabhavati || 8.30 || piṣṭiḥ kāryā gandhakenendumauler ūrdhvaṃ cādho gandhamādāya tulyam | dhāryā madhye pakvamūṣā tuṣāgnau sthāpyā cetthaṃ manyate gandhadāhaḥ || 8.31 || <ānandasūtarasaḥ> śuddhaṃ rasaṃ samaviṣaṃ praharaṃ vimardya tadgolakaṃ kanakacāruphale nidhāya | dolāgataṃ pañcadinaṃ viṣamuṣṭitoye prakṣālya tatpunarapīha tathā dvivāram || 8.32 || tatsūtake giriśalocanayugmagandhaṃ yuktyāvajārya kuru bhasma samaṃ ca tasya | vaikrāntabhasma jayapālanavāṃśakārdhaṃ sarvair viṣaṃ dviguṇitaṃ mṛditaṃ ca khalve || 8.33 || ghasratrayaṃ kanakabhṛṅgarasena gāḍham āveśya bhājanatale viṣadhūpabhāji | bhṛṅgadraveṇa śithilaṃ laghukācakūpyām āpūrya ruddhavadanāṃ sikatākhyayantre || 8.34 || tāṃ vāsarārtham upadīpya nisargaśītāṃ dṛṣṭvā vicūrṇya gadaśāliṣu śālimātram | ānandasūtam akhilāmayakumbhisiṃhaṃ gadyāṇakārdhasitayā saha dehi paścāt || 8.35 || rogānurūpamanupānamapi prakāśaṃ kṣoṇībhujāṃ pracurapūjanamāpnuhi tvam | kīrtyā diśo dhavalaya sphuradindukāntyā vaidyeśvareti virudaṃ bhaja vaidyarāja || 8.36 || mākṣīkakanakau gandhaṃ bhrāmayitvā vicūrṇayet | rasaṃ gandhād dvibhāgaṃ ca sikatāyantragaṃ pacet || 8.37 || dinamevaṃ ca tāraṃ vā jarārogaharaṃ mahat | rasena piṣṭvā svarṇaṃ vā tāpyaṃ paścād vimiśrayet || 8.38 || tāpyasthāne mṛtaṃ tālaṃ tārakarmaṇi kasyacit | rasasaṃkhyānpuṭāndadyādgandhairvā vīryavṛddhaye || 8.39 || sūtaṃ gandhaṃ kāntapāṣāṇamiśraṃ brāhmair bījair mardayed ekaghasram | golaṃ kṛtvā ṭaṅkaṇena praveṣṭya paścānmṛtsnāgomayābhyāṃ dhamettam || 8.40 || śuṣkaṃ yantre sattvapātapradhāne kiṭṭaḥ sūto baddhatāmeti nūnam | baddhaṃ paścāt sārakācaprayogāddhemnā tulyaṃ sūtamāvartayettu || 8.41 || vaktre golaḥ sthāpito vatsarārthaṃ rogān sarvānhanti saukhyaṃ karoti | yadvā dugdhe golakaṃ pācayitvā dadyād dugdhaṃ pippalībhiḥ kṣaye tat || 8.42 || lauhe pātre pācayitvā tu deyaṃ śuṣke pāṇḍau kāmale pittaroge | vāte golaṃ vyoṣavātāritaile paktvā tailaṃ gandhayuktaṃ dadīta || 8.43 || bhārṅgīmuṇḍīkāsamardāṭarūṣadrāvair golaṃ pācayecchleṣmanuttyai | kāse śvāse taṃ ca dadyāt kaṣāyaṃ mādhvīkāktaṃ pippalīcūrṇayuktam || 8.44 || yasmin roge yaḥ kaṣāyo'sti coktastasmin golaṃ pācayitvā kaṣāye | dadyāttattadroganāśāya pathyaṃ tattadroge kīrtitaṃ yattadeva || 8.45 || ukto golaḥ prāṇikalpadrumo'yaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā yojayedbhaktiyogāt | rasasya dviguṇaṃ gandhaṃ śuddhaṃ saṃmardayed dinam | pratilauhaṃ sūtatulyamaṣṭalauhaṃ mṛtaṃ kṣipet || 8.46 || brāhmī jayantī nirguṇḍī madhuyaṣṭī punarnavā | nīlikā girikarṇyarkakṛṣṇadhattūrakaṃ yavāḥ || 8.47 || āṭarūṣaḥ kākamācī dravairāsāṃ vimardayet | guñjātrayaṃ catuṣkaṃ vā sarvarogeṣu yojayet | rogoktamanupānaṃ vā kavoṣṇaṃ vā jalaṃ pibet || 8.48 || rasagandhakatāmrāṇi sindhuvārarasaudanam | mardayedātape paścādvālukāyantramadhyagam || 8.49 || ruddhvā mūṣāgataṃ yāmatrayaṃ tīvrāgninā pacet | tadguñjā sarvarogeṣu parṇakhaṇḍikayā saha || 8.50 || dātavyā dehasiddhyarthaṃ puṣṭivīryabalāya ca | raso'yaṃ hematārābhyām api sidhyati kanyayā || 8.51 || sūtabhasma caturbhāgaṃ lauhabhasma tathāṣṭakam | meghabhasma ca ṣaḍbhāgaṃ śuddhagandhasya pañcakam || 8.52 || bhāvayettriphalākvāthais tat sarvaṃ bhṛṅgajairdravaiḥ | śigruvahṇikaṭukyadbhiḥ saptadhā bhāvayetpṛthak || 8.53 || sarvatulyā kaṇā yojyā guḍairmiśraṃ purātanaiḥ | niṣkamātraṃ sadā khādejjarāṃ mṛtyuṃ nihantyalam || 8.54 || brahmāyuḥsyāccaturmāsai raso'yamamṛtārṇavaḥ | tilakauraṇṭapatrāṇi guḍena bhakṣayedanu || 8.55 || ardhaṃ pāradatulyena tāraṃ tāmreṇa melayet | mārayet sikatāyantre śilāhiṅgulagandhakaiḥ || 8.56 || ayaṃ ratneśvaraḥ sūtaḥ sarvatraiva prayujyate | hemno 'ntaryojito hyeṣo hematāṃ pratipadyate || 8.57 || śeṣo'rkaścedgandhakairvā kunaṭyā vāhatadvipaiḥ | śodhayet kanakaṃ samyag anyair vā kālikāpahaiḥ | varṇahrāse tu tāpyena kārayedvarṇamuttamam || 8.58 || praṇamya śaṅkaraṃ rudraṃ daṇḍapāṇiṃ maheśvaram | jīvitārogyamanvicchannārado'pṛcchadīśvaram || 8.59 || sukhopāyena he nātha śastrakṣārāgnibhirvinā | durbalānāṃ ca bhīrūṇāṃ cikitsāṃ vaktumarhasi || 8.60 || tacchiṣyavacanaṃ śrutvā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | arśasāṃ nāśanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhaiṣajyam idam īritam || 8.61 || pāṇḍivajrādilohānām ādāyānyatamaṃ śubham | kṛtvā nirmalam ādau tu kunaṭyā mākṣikeṇa ca || 8.62 || pattūramūlakalkena svarasena dahettataḥ | vahnau nikṣipya vidhivacchālāṅgāreṇa nirdhamet || 8.63 || jvālā ca tasya roddhavyā triphalāyā rasena ca | tato vijñāya galitaṃ śaṅkunordhvaṃ samutkṣipet || 8.64 || triphalāyā rase pūte tadākṛṣya tu nirvapet | na samyaggalitaṃ yattu tenaiva vidhinā punaḥ || 8.65 || dhmātaṃ nirvāpayettasmiṃllauhaṃ tattriphalārase | yallauhaṃ na mṛtaṃ tatra pācyaṃ bhūyo'pi pūrvavat || 8.66 || māraṇānna mṛtaṃ yacca tat tyaktavyam alauhavat | tataḥ saṃśoṣya vidhivaccūrṇayellauhabhājane || 8.67 || lohakhalve tathā piṃṣyād dṛṣadi ślakṣṇacūrṇitam | kṛtvā lohamaye pātre sārdre vā liptarandhake || 8.68 || rasaiḥ paṅkasamaṃ kṛtvā pacettadgomayāgninā | puṭāni kramaśo dadyātpṛthageṣāṃ vidhānataḥ || 8.69 || triphalārdrakabhṛṅgāṇāṃ keśarājasya buddhimān | mānakandakabhallātavahnīnāṃ sūraṇasya ca || 8.70 || hastikarṇapalāśasya kuliśasya tathaiva ca | puṭe puṭe cūrṇayitvā lohātṣoḍaśikaṃ palam || 8.71 || tanmānaṃ triphalāyāśca palenādhikam āharet | aṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭe tu rase tasyāḥ paced budhaḥ || 8.72 || aṣṭau palāni dattvā tu sarpiṣo lohabhājane | tāmre vā lohadarvyā tu cālayed vidhipūrvakam || 8.73 || tataḥ pākavidhānajñaḥ svacche cordhve ca sarpiṣi | mṛdumadhyādibhedena gṛhṇīyātpākamanyataḥ || 8.74 || ārabheta vidhānena kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ | ghṛtabhrāmarasaṃyuktaṃ lihed ā raktikaṃ kramāt || 8.75 || vardhamānānupānaṃ ca gavyaṃ kṣīrottamaṃ matam | gavyābhāve'pyajāyāśca snigdhavṛṣyādibhojanam || 8.76 || sadyo vahṇikaraṃ caiva bhasmakaṃ ca niyacchati | hanti vātaṃ tathā pittaṃ kuṣṭhāni viṣamajvaram || 8.77 || gulmākṣipāṇḍurogāṃśca tandrālasyamarocakam | pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlaṃ pramehamapabāhukam || 8.78 || śvayathuṃ rudhirasrāvaṃ durnāmānaṃ viśeṣataḥ | balakṛd bṛṃhaṇaṃ caiva kāntidaṃ svaravardhanam || 8.79 || śarīralāghavakaramārogyaṃ puṣṭivardhanam | āyuṣyaṃ śrīkaraṃ caiva vayastejaskaraṃ tathā || 8.80 || saśrīkaputrajananaṃ valīpalitanāśanam | durnāmārir ayaṃ nāmnā dṛṣṭo vārān sahasraśaḥ | nirmūlaṃ dahyate śīghraṃ yathā tūlaṃ ca vahṇinā || 8.81 || saukumāryālpakāyatve madyasevāṃ samācaret | jīrṇamadyāni yuktāni bhojanaiḥ saha pāyayet || 8.82 || lāvatittirivartīramayūraśaśakādayaḥ | caṭakaḥ kalaviṅkaśca vartako haritālakaḥ || 8.83 || śyenakaśca bṛhallāvo vanaviṣkirakādayaḥ | pārāvatamṛgādīnāṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalajaṃ tathā || 8.84 || madguro rohitaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śakulaśca viśeṣataḥ | matsyarājā ime proktā hitamatsyeṣu yojayet || 8.85 || praśastaṃ vārtākaphalaṃ paṭolaṃ bṛhatīphalam | pralambābhīruvetrāgrajātukaṃ taṇḍulīyakam || 8.86 || vāstukaṃ dhānyaśākaṃ ca karṇālukapunarnavām | nārikelaṃ ca kharjūraṃ dāḍimaṃ lavalīphalam || 8.87 || śṛṅgāṭakaṃ ca pakvāmraṃ drākṣā tālaphalāni ca | jātikoṣaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca pūgaṃ tāmbūlapatrakam | hitānyetāni vasūni lohametatsamaśnatām || 8.88 || nāśnīyāllakucaṃ kolakarkandhubadarāṇi ca | jambīraṃ bījapūraṃ ca tintiḍīkaramardakam || 8.89 || ānūpāni ca māṃsāni krakaraṃ puṇḍrakādikam | haṃsasārasadātyūhacāṣakrauñcabalākikāḥ || 8.90 || māṣakandakarīrāṇi caṇakaṃ ca kaliṅgakam | kūṣmāṇḍakaṃ ca karkoṭīṃ kebukaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 8.91 || kañcaṭaṃ kāravellaṃ ca kaśeruṃ karkaṭīṃ tathā | vidalāni ca sarvāṇi kakārādīṃśca varjayet || 8.92 || śaṅkareṇa samākhyāto yakṣarājānukampayā | jagatāmupakārāya durnāmārirayaṃ dhruvam || 8.93 || sthānādapaiti meruśca pṛthvī paryeti vāyunā | patanti candratārāśca mithyā cedahamabruvam || 8.94 || brahmaghnāśca kṛtaghnāśca krūrāścāsatyavādinaḥ | varjanīyā vidagdhena bhaiṣajyagurunindakāḥ || 8.95 || munirasapiṣṭaviḍaṅgaṃ munirasalīḍhaṃ cirasthitaṃ gharme | drāvayati lohadoṣān vahṇirnavanītapiṇḍamiva || 8.96 || kṛmiripucūrṇaṃ līḍhaṃ sahitaṃ svarasena vaṅgasenasya | kṣapayatyacirānniyataṃ lohājīrṇodbhavaṃ śūlam || 8.97 || jīrṇe lauhe tvapatati cūrṇaṃ bhuñjīta siddhisārākhyam | lauhavyāpannaśyati vivardhate jāṭharo vahṇiḥ || 8.98 || pathyāsaindhavaśuṇṭhīmāgadhikānāṃ pṛthaksamo bhāgaḥ | trivṛtābhāgau nimbūbhāvyaṃ syāt siddhisārākhyam || 8.99 || āragvadhasya majjābhī recanaṃ kiṭṭaśāntaye | bhavedyadatisārastu dugdhaṃ pītvā tu taṃ jayet || 8.100 || raktidvādaśakād ūrdhvaṃ vṛddhirasya bhayapradā || 8.101 || kāle malapravṛttirlāghavamudare viśuddhir udgāre | aṅgeṣu nāvasādo manaḥprasādo'sya paripāke || 8.102 || nāgārjuno munīndraḥ śaśāsa yallohaśāstram atigahanam | tasyārthasya smṛtaye vayametadviśadākṣarairbrūmaḥ || 8.103 || mene muniḥ svatantre yaḥ pākaṃ na palapañcakādarvāk | subahuprayogadoṣād ūrdhvaṃ ca palatrayodaśakāt || 8.104 || tatrāyasi pacanīye pañcapalādau trayodaśapalakānte | lauhāttriguṇā triphalā grāhyā ṣaḍbhiḥ palairadhikā || 8.105 || māraṇapuṭanasthālīpākās triphalaikabhāgasaṃpādyāḥ | triphalābhāgadvitayaṃ grahaṇīyaṃ lauhapākārtham || 8.106 || sarvatrāyaḥ puṭanādyarthaikāṃśe śarāvasaṃkhyātam | pratipalameva triguṇaṃ pāthaḥ kvāthārthamādeyam || 8.107 || saptapalādau bhāge pañcadaśānte'mbhasāṃ śarāvaiśca | tryādyaikādaśakāntair adhikaṃ tadvāri kartavyam || 8.108 || tatrāṣṭamo vibhāgaḥ śeṣaḥ kvāthasya yatnataḥ sthāpyaḥ | tena hi māraṇapuṭanasthālīpākā bhaviṣyanti || 8.109 || pākārthe tu triphalābhāgadvitaye śarāvasaṃkhyātam | pratipalamambu samaṃ syādadhikaṃ dvābhyāṃ śarāvābhyām || 8.110 || tatra caturtho bhāgaḥ śeṣo nipuṇaiḥ prayatnato grāhyaḥ | ayasaḥ pākārthatvātsa ca sarvasmāt pradhānatamaḥ || 8.111 || pākārthamaśmasāre pañcapalādau trayodaśapalānte | dugdhaśarāvadvitayaṃ pādair ekādikair adhikam || 8.112 || pañcapalādirmātrā tadabhāve tadanusārato grāhyam | caturādikam ekāntaṃ śaktāvadhikaṃ trayodaśakāt || 8.113 || triphalātrikaṭukacitrakakāntakrāmakaviḍaṅgacūrṇāni | jātīphalasya jātīkoṣailākaṅkolalavaṅgānām | sitakṛṣṇajīrakayor api cūrṇānyayasā samāni syuḥ || 8.114 || triphalātrikaṭuviḍaṅgā niyatā anye yathāprakṛti bodhyāḥ | kālāyasadoṣahṛte jātīphalāderlavaṅgakāntasya | kṣepaḥ prāptyanurūpaḥ sarvasyonasya caikādyaiḥ || 8.115 || kāntakrāmakamekaṃ niḥśeṣaṃ doṣamapaharatyayasaḥ || 8.116 || dviguṇatriguṇacaturguṇamājyaṃ grāhyaṃ yathāprakṛti || 8.117 || yadi bheṣajabhūyastvaṃ stokatvaṃ vā tathāpi cūrṇānām | ayasā sāmyaṃ saṃkhyā bhūyo'lpatvena bhūyo'lpā || 8.118 || evaṃ dhātvanusārāttattatkathitauṣadhasya bādhena | sarvatraiva vidheyas tattatkathitasyauṣadhasyohaḥ || 8.119 || kāntādilauhamāraṇavidhānasarvasvam ucyate tāvat | yasya kṛte tallauhaṃ paktavyaṃ tasya śubhe divase || 8.120 || samṛdaṅgārakarālitanatabhūbhāge śivaṃ samabhyarcya | vaidikavidhinā vahṇiṃ nidhāya dattvāhutīstatra || 8.121 || dharmāt sidhyati sarvaṃ śreyastaddharmasiddhaye sarvadā peyā kṣīrasitānuvīryakaraṇe stambhe'pyayaṃ kāminām | vāmāvaśyakaraḥ sukhātisukhadaḥ prauḍhāṅganādrāvakaḥ kṣīṇe puṣṭikaraḥ kṣayakṣayakaro nānāmayadhvaṃsakaḥ || 8.238 || kāsaśvāsamahātisāraśamano mandāgnisandīpanaḥ durnāmagrahaṇīpramehanivahaśleṣmāsrapittapraṇut | nityānandakaro viśeṣakavitāvācāṃ vilāsodbhavaṃ dhatte sarvaguṇaṃ mahāsthiravayo dhyānāvadhāne 'pyalam || 8.239 || abhyāsena nihanti mṛtyupalitaṃ kāmeśvaro vatsarāt sarveṣāṃ hitakāriṇā nigaditaḥ śrīnityanāthena saḥ | vṛddhānām api kāmavardhanakaraḥ prauḍhāṅganāsaṅgame siddho'yaṃ mama dṛṣṭipratyayakaro bhūpaiḥ sadā sevyatām || 8.240 || vṛṣyagaṇacūrṇatulyaṃ tat puṭapakvaṃ ghanaṃ sitā dviguṇam | vṛṣyātparamativṛṣyaṃ rasāyanaṃ cūrṇaratnamidam || 8.241 || <śṛṅgārābhrarasaḥ> śuddhaṃ kṛṣṇābhracūrṇaṃ dvipalaparimitaṃ śāṇamānaṃ yadanyat | karpūraṃ jātikoṣaṃ sajalamibhakaṇā tejapatraṃ lavaṅgam || 8.242 || māṃsī tālīśacoce gajakusumagadaṃ dhātakī ceti tulyaṃ | pathyā dhātrī vibhītaṃ trikaṭuratha pṛthak tvarddhaśāṇaṃ dviśāṇam || 8.243 || elājātīphalākhyaṃ kṣititalavidhinā śuddhagandhāśmakolaṃ kolārddhaṃ pāradasya pratipadavihitaṃ piṣṭamekatra miśram | pānīyenaiva kāryāḥ pariṇatacaṇakasvinnatulyāśca vaṭyaḥ prātaḥ khādyāś catasras tadanu ca hi kiyacchṛṅgaveraṃ saparṇam || 8.244 || pānīyaṃ pītamante dhruvamapaharati kṣiprametān vikārān koṣṭhe duṣṭāgnijātān jvaramudararujo rājayakṣmaṃ kṣayaṃ ca | kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ saśothaṃ nayanaparibhavaṃ mehamedovikārān chardiṃ śūlāmlapittaṃ tṛṣamapi mahatīṃ gulmajālaṃ viśālam || 8.245 || pāṇḍutvaṃ raktapittaṃ garalabhavagadān pīnasaṃ plīharogaṃ hanyād āmānilotthān kaphapavanakṛtān pittarogānaśeṣān | balyo vṛṣyaśca yogastaruṇatarakaraḥ sarvaroge praśastaḥ pathyaṃ māṃsaiśca yūṣair ghṛtaparilulitair gavyadugdhaiśca bhūyaḥ || 8.246 || bhojyaṃ yojyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ lalitalalanayā dīyamānaṃ mudā yacchṛṅgārābhreṇa kāmī yuvatijanaśatāṃ bhogayogādatuṣṭaḥ | varjyaṃ śākāmlamādau dinakatipayacit svecchayā bhojyamanyad dīrghāyuḥ kāmamūrtir gatavalipalito mānavo'sya prasādāt || 8.247 || viṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ mustaṃ haridrā nimbapatrakam | viḍaṅgamaṣṭamaṃ cūrṇaṃ chāgamūtraiḥ samaṃ samam | caṇakābhā vaṭī kāryā syājjayā yogavāhikā || 8.248 || ādau gandhahataṃ śulvaṃ paścāttulyāhipāradam | trinetro haviṣā piṣṭaḥ śītavīryo'rddhagandhakaḥ || 8.249 || uṣṇaścettulyagandhena kuryāt saṃmardya parpaṭīm | dehasiddhikaro hyeṣa sarvaroganikṛntanaḥ || 8.250 || śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ khalve ghṛṣṭvā tu kajjalīm | tayoḥ samaṃ kāntalauhamabhāve tasya tīkṣṇakam || 8.251 || melitaṃ devadeveśi marditaṃ kanyakādravaiḥ | yāmadvayaṃ tataḥ paścāttadgolaṃ tāmrasampuṭe || 8.252 || ācchādyairaṇḍapatraistu dhānyarāśau nidhāpayet | tridinānte samuddhṛtya piṣṭaṃ vāritaraṃ bhavet || 8.253 || kumārī bhṛṅgakoraṇṭau kākamācī punarnavā | nīlī muṇḍī ca nirguṇḍī sahadevī śatāvarī || 8.254 || amlaparṇī gokṣurakaḥ kacchūmūlaṃ vaṭāṅkurāḥ | eteṣāṃ bhāvayeddrāvaiḥ saptavārān pṛthak pṛthak || 8.255 || tryūṣaṇatriphalāsomarājīnāṃ ca kaṣāyakaiḥ | śuṣke'smiṃstolitaṃ cūrṇaṃ samamekādaśābhidham || 8.256 || varāvyoṣāgniviśvailā jātīphalalavaṅgakam | saṃyojya madhunāloḍya vimardyedaṃ bhajetsadā || 8.257 || rātrau pibed gavāṃ kṣīraṃ kṛṣṇānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | saṃvatsarājjarāmṛtyurogajālaṃ nivārayet || 8.258 || vīryavṛddhikaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rāmāśatasukhapradam | tāvanna cyavate vīryaṃ yāvadamlaṃ na sevate || 8.259 || dīpanaṃ kāntidaṃ puṣṭituṣṭikṛtsevināṃ sadā | suguptaḥ kathitaḥ sūtaḥ siddhayogeśvarābhidhaḥ || 8.260 || triphalā lohajaṃ cūrṇaṃ raktacitrakajā jaṭā | cyutakṣudrāmrakaṃ bījaṃ pālāśaṃ kṣudradugdhikā || 8.261 || etadaṣṭakamādāya pṛthak pañcapalonmitam | miśrayitvā palāśasya sarvāṅgarasabhāvitam || 8.262 || mahākālajabījānāṃ bhāgatrayamathāharet | bhāgaṃ kṛṣṇatilasyaikaṃ miśrayitvā nipīḍayet || 8.263 || tena tailena taccūrṇaṃ piṇḍīkāryaṃ vimardanāt | snigdhe bhāṇḍe tadādhāya śarāveṇa nirodhayet || 8.264 || liptvā tadāśu dhānye ca palalaughe nidhāpayet | māsamātrātsamāhṛtya pūjayitvā śivaṃ śivam || 8.265 || tolaikaṃ bhakṣayetprātastolaikaṃ bhojanopari | evaṃ māsatrayābhyāsātpalitaṃ hantyasaṃśayam | varṣaikena jarāṃ hatvā mṛtyuṃ jayati mānavaḥ || 8.266 || kajjalīkṛtasugandhakaśambhos tulyabhāgakanakasya bījam | mardayetkanakatailayutaṃ syāt kāminīmadavidhūnana eṣaḥ || 8.267 || asya vallayugalaṃ sasitaṃ cet sevitaṃ harati mehagaṇaugham | vīryadārḍhyakaraṇaṃ kamanīyaṃ drāvaṇaṃ nidhuvane vanitānām || 8.268 || rasagandhakalauhābhraṃ samaṃ sūtāṅghri hema ca | sarvaṃ khalvatale kṣiptvā kanyāsvarasamarditam || 8.269 || triphalātulasībrāhmīrasaiścānu vimardayet | eraṇḍapatrairāveṣṭya dhānyarāśau dinatrayam || 8.270 || saṃsthāpya ca taduddhṛtya triphalāmadhusaṃyutam | etadrasāyanavaraṃ sarvarogeṣu yojayet || 8.271 || tadyathāgnibalaṃ khādedvalīpalitanāśanam | pauṣṭikaṃ balyamāyuṣyaṃ putraprasavakārakam || 8.272 || kṣayamekādaśavidhaṃ kāsaṃ pañcavidhaṃ tathā | kuṣṭhamaṣṭādaśavidhaṃ pāṇḍurogān pramehakān || 8.273 || śūlaṃ śvāsaṃ ca hikkāṃ ca mandāgniṃ cāmlapittakam | vraṇān sarvānāmavātaṃ visarpaṃ vidradhiṃ tathā || 8.274 || apasmāraṃ mahonmādaṃ sarvārśāṃsi tvagāmayān | krameṇa śīlitaṃ hanti vṛkṣamindrāśaniryathā | caturmukhena devena kṛṣṇātreyāya sūcitam || 8.275 || gandhaṃ lauhaṃ bhasma madhvājyayuktaṃ sevyaṃ varṣaṃ vāriṇā traiphalena | śukle keśe kālimā divyadṛṣṭiḥ puṣṭivīryaṃ jāyate dīrghamāyuḥ || 8.276 || aṣṭāṃśahemni haraje śikhimūṣikāyāṃ saṃjārya ṣaḍguṇabaliṃ kramaśo 'dhikaṃ ca | ūrdhvaṃ payo'gnim adhare vinidhāya dhīrāḥ siddhīḥ samagramatulāḥ svakare kurudhvam || 8.277 || lauhaṃ gandhaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ bhrāmayitvā sārdhas tasmin sūtako'nyaśca gandhaḥ | kanyāmbhobhir marditaḥ kācakūpyāṃ kṣipto vahṇau siddhaye vahṇisiddhaḥ || 8.278 ||
